svg.text: THE FLUX ACROSS A FACE, DIFFERENCE × CONDUCTANCE, FOR K = 80
s, the difference across a face
beyond K: a bigger jump leaks less
below K the flux grows with the jump:
above K it shrinks: the step (160) and
a 20-level bump is on the rising side
and diffuses almost as in the heat equation
at 160 and 0.16 at 215: it all but
